name: Craighead County, AR
findings: Craighead County has 214 nonprofit organizations. 91 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 74 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Craighead County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Craighead County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 70 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 14 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list membership
observations.text: 3 hobby and sports organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Youth organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 7 youth organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do youth organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
